an3.14:1.4: “Principle” here is _dhamma_. This is an example of how _dhamma_ is broader than the Buddha’s teaching. In guiding a king, it is the way nature is, the laws that describe reality, which inform the proper conduct in line with the natural order.
an3.14:5.2: This is a reference to the Buddha’s first teaching at [sn56.11]().
